guitar.modelsText: Epiphone Sheraton / Gibson ES-355 / Gibson Les Paul
guitar.notes: Noel Gallagher's Epiphone Sheraton (Union Jack edition) and Gibson ES-355/Les Pauls are iconic and well documented.

tone.target: dirty Britpop rhythm crunch with fuzzy edge
tone.profile: dirty Britpop rhythm crunch with fuzzy edge
tone.summary: A crunchy, raw Britpop rhythm tone using a Plexi-style amp and fuzz for grit, focused on upper mids.
